_about.what: HISTORICAL ARCHIVE — NOT SERVED. The pain points in src/data/agency-pain-points.json tagged "(Source: GAO)", each traced to the GovInfo GAOREPORTS document it was copied from.
_about.why: Data Core audit 2026-11-17: every one is a GAO document published 1993-2000, copied via agency_intelligence (gao_high_risk, mislabeled fiscal_year 2026). Agency attribution is INHERITED from agency_intelligence, whose extractor matched agency names as substrings — so a served agency agreeing with its source row is not evidence the attribution is right (e.g. an NLRB strategic-plan testimony filed under Veterans Affairs in both places). source_row_agencies lists every agency the same document was filed under.
_about.status: The served JSON still contains these strings unchanged. Retirement requires a separate approval.
